stage: fixed eight-workload training screen; no new candidate or tuning
build_order: prehashed then common-hash every repetition; one fresh bitmap per contract
filter_order: Original source shuffle followed by explicit reversal for seed6011 only. Each geometry/chunk has control-first and candidate-first once.
case_order: Seed5011 four cells forward, seed6011 four cells reverse, as already frozen
order_limit: Relative filter position is balanced across two seeds; pure/common build phase order stays fixed, as does code placement. No independent order-effect or significance claim.

analysis.ratio: candidate latency / control latency; >1 is slower
analysis.priority: Report whole allocation-plus-build as well as insert-only; never infer construction superiority from insertion-only improvement
analysis.retention: All per-size/chunk/seed/metric medians, every trial, every loss/tie; no pooled significance calculation
analysis.shared_samples: Insert and allocate-plus-insert are nested intervals of the same build operation, not independent samples
analysis.query_role: Semantic validation only; do not rank query latencies
analysis.quality_role: Exact bitmap mapping proof and equal same-input FP/output records; no new calibration or FPR advantage claim
analysis.decision: Reject if not useful; any promising screen still requires a separately frozen confirmation before production promotion
